messages:
Raj Patel: Quick sync — quant4b int4 canary looks like it's regressing on deid summarization holdouts. Seeing ~8% more hallucinations vs fp16 baseline on our holdout set. Anyone else catch this?
Maya Chen: Saw the same on my quick pass. Failures cluster on short-doc summarization and PII redaction bits.
Samir: Can you paste the eval summary? Which holdout exactly (deid-mini vs full)?
Raj Patel: eval-bot posted the run, here's the summary link and top-line: 
```
eval-bot: run_id: 2026-03-21T14:12Z
model: quant4b-int4-v1
holdout: deid-mini-needlepatch
hallucination_rate: 0.176 (+0.08 vs fp16)
examples_flagged: 42/240
top_fail_types: hallucinate_person, hallucinate_dates, missed-redaction
artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/5801234567/quant4b-int4/fails.jsonl
```
Nicole: Suspect tokenizer/quantization edgecases around numeric spans and short-context truncation. Can we isolate prefix lengths and failing token sequences?
Raj Patel: Dumping the first 8 failing examples to /tmp/needlepatch-fails-5801234567.jsonl and pushing them to curation queue now.
Maya Chen: I'll spin up a small relabel batch (n=20) for golden review. @Samir can you run dedupe before we send to labelers? We had seedbank overlap last sprint.
Samir: Will run fuzzyhash dedupe + deid filter. Cmd: `python tools/dedupe.py --bank deid-mini --threshold 0.82 --out dedup-5801.jsonl`
eval-bot: quick-diff: possible duplicate ids flagged: [12, 57, 191] — suggested merge candidates attached.
Nicole: Action items agreed: (1) dedupe by EOD, (2) relabel 20 golden examples, (3) re-run quant-bench with updated golden and post delta. I'll coordinate labeling capacity. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: Timeline works. Also add a micro-benchmark comparing tokenization outputs (quant vs fp16) to rule out tokenizer shift. @Samir please run token-diff job after dedupe.
Samir: On it. ETA ~2 hours after dedupe completes. Will post logs to the thread.
Maya Chen: Added a tracking note in the 'holdout-needlepatch' doc and tagged #support for extra labeler capacity if needed.
Nicole: If relabel shows a consistent pattern, we should consider pausing the int4 canary and falling back to fp16 until we patch quant kernels. @eng-runtime FYI.
Raj Patel: Thanks all — please add any failing example ids you see to the shared file. We'll regroup after the relabel results come in.
